title: Mechanic Registration Page, Admin Panel Fixes, and UI Cleanup

requirements.summary: Replace 'Become a Mechanic' WhatsApp link with '👨‍🔧 Mechanic Registration' navigation item in NavigationDrawer
acceptanceCriteria: Hamburger menu no longer shows 'Become a Mechanic'
'👨‍🔧 Mechanic Registration' appears in the NavigationDrawer
Clicking it navigates to /mechanic-registration
All other menu items remain unchanged

file_operations.description: Remove the existing WhatsApp link for 'Become a Mechanic' and replace it with a new menu item '👨‍🔧 Mechanic Registration' that navigates to '/mechanic-registration' using the same pattern as other menu items. Keep all other navigation links (Home, Services, About, Contact, Terms, Booking History) unchanged. Ensure the new item appears in the natural flow of the menu items and triggers drawer close on click.

requirements.summary: Remove FloatingCallButton component from the website
acceptanceCriteria: The circular 'Call Now' floating button is no longer visible anywhere on the website
FloatingWhatsAppButton remains intact and functional
No console errors related to the removed component

file_operations.description: Remove the import statement for FloatingCallButton and remove its usage from the component tree. Ensure FloatingWhatsAppButton remains rendered and functional. Verify no other files import or reference FloatingCallButton.

requirements.summary: Create MechanicRegistrationPage with form, formsubmit.co integration, and GPay-style success overlay
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /mechanic-registration shows the registration form page
All specified fields are present with correct input types
Required fields show validation errors if left empty on submit
Form submits via POST to https://formsubmit.co/pandeyxkanha@gmail.com
All hidden fields (_subject, _template, _captcha, _next, _honey) are present
On submit, a full-screen success overlay with animated green checkmark appears
playSuccessSound() is called on successful submission
Submit button is orange (#ff8c42) and scales on hover
Page is fully mobile-responsive

file_operations.description: Create a full-page registration form component with the following fields: Full Name (text, required), Phone Number (tel, required), Email (email, optional), Service Type (dropdown: Plumber, Electrician, Fan/Cooler Repair, AC Repair, Mechanic, required), Experience (dropdown: Less than 1 year, 1-3 years, 3-5 years, 5+ years, required), Address in Mahipalpur (textarea, required), Age (number, optional), Preferred Area (dropdown: Mahipalpur Extension, Village, Aerocity, Other, optional), Why want to join? (textarea, optional). Include hidden fields: _subject='👨‍🔧 New Mechanic Registration', _template='table', _captcha='false', _next='https://quickrepair-84g.caffeine.xyz/mechanic-thankyou.html', _honey (display:none honeypot). On form submit, show a full-screen success overlay matching BookingSuccessOverlay pattern with animated green checkmark SVG, call playSuccessSound(), then allow formsubmit redirect after ~2 seconds. Submit button: '📝 Register as Mechanic', bg #ff8c42, hover scale 1.05. Use dark theme colors (#0a2b3c background, #ff8c42 orange, #FFD700 yellow). Ensure mobile-responsive layout. Before the formsubmit redirect occurs, also call submitMechanicRegistration() on the backend actor (using useActor hook and useMutation pattern from useQueries.ts) to store the data in the canister. Handle both the formsubmit POST and the backend call, allowing the formsubmit redirect to proceed after the success overlay.

Add a new useMutation hook useSubmitMechanicRegistration that calls actor.submitMechanicRegistration(name, phone, email, serviceType, experience, address, age, preferredArea, whyJoin) to store mechanic registration data in the backend. Follow the existing mutation pattern used by useAddFeedback and useRegisterUser.

acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /mechanic-registration renders MechanicRegistrationPage
Existing routes (/admin, /booking, /booking-history, /) continue to work

file_operations.description: Import MechanicRegistrationPage and add a route condition that renders it when pathname is '/mechanic-registration'. Follow the existing routing pattern used for /admin, /booking, and /booking-history. Ensure all existing routes remain functional.

requirements.summary: Fix admin panel authorization for service CRUD operations
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can add a new service from /admin without getting 'Unauthorized User' error
Admin can edit and delete existing services
Added services persist after page refresh

file_operations.description: Review the admin authentication flow and ensure the component correctly passes the authenticated actor to all service CRUD operations (add, edit, delete). Verify that the password session state is properly maintained and that the actor used in mutations is the authenticated one from useActor. Check error handling and display clear error messages if authorization fails. Note: The backend authorization logic is handled separately; this file operation ensures the frontend correctly uses the authenticated actor.

requirements.summary: Replace hardcoded services in ServicesSection with dynamic backend data
acceptanceCriteria: Services added in the admin panel appear in the ServicesSection on the homepage
If no services are stored in backend, a reasonable fallback (empty state or default services) is shown
ServicesSection re-fetches when services are updated

file_operations.description: Add a new useQuery hook useGetAllServices that calls actor.getAllServices() to fetch the services list from the backend. Follow the existing query pattern used by useGetAllFeedback. Include proper enabled/retry/staleTime configuration to ensure services are fetched when the actor is available.

Replace the hardcoded services array with a dynamic fetch using the new useGetAllServices hook. Map over the fetched services to render ServiceCard components. If the backend returns an empty array or the query is loading, display a loading state or fallback to the existing hardcoded services. Ensure the ServiceCard receives the correct service data structure (id, name, description, icon, startingPrice). Handle loading and error states gracefully.

requirements.summary: Add Mechanic Registrations section to AdminPage to display stored registration data
acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel /admin shows a 'Mechanic Registrations' section with all submitted registrations
Each registration shows: Full Name, Phone, Email, Service Type, Experience, Address, Age, Preferred Area, Why Join
New mechanic registrations submitted via the form appear in the admin panel
Only admin can view mechanic registrations (auth-protected)

file_operations.description: Add a new useQuery hook useGetMechanicRegistrations that calls actor.getMechanicRegistrations() to fetch all mechanic registration records from the backend. Follow the existing admin query pattern (e.g., useGetAllBookings). Ensure the query is only enabled when the actor is available.

Add a new 'Mechanic Registrations' section/tab to the admin dashboard using the useGetMechanicRegistrations hook. Display all registrations in a table or card layout with columns: Full Name, Phone, Email, Service Type, Experience, Address, Age, Preferred Area, Why Join. Include timestamp if available. Handle loading and error states. Ensure the section is only visible to authenticated admins (leveraging the existing password session or admin check). Format the data for readability and ensure mobile responsiveness.
